name: logimart-erp
description: Logimart ERP monorepo root — delegates build/start into apps/api for Railway (Nixpacks).

scripts.build: (cd apps/api && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && npm run build) && (cd apps/web && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build) && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
